raw_description_html:
A cup for every part of your day.

Three caffeine-free herbal blends, a clear glass teapot and a gold-tone measuring spoon: everything you need for a calming tea ritual from first light to lights out. Lovely on your own counter, and a thoughtful gift.

What's inside

  • Glass teapot (600 ml): heat-resistant borosilicate glass with a removable stainless steel infuser. Safe on a gas stove.
  • Measuring spoon: stainless steel with a gold-tone finish.
  • Three loose-leaf herbal teas (100 g each), all caffeine-free:
    • Ginger & Lemongrass, for mornings: bright, zesty and warming.
    • Forest Fruits, for afternoons: sweet berries and hibiscus.
    • Peachy Chamomile, for evenings: soft, mellow and soothing.

Made with care

  • 100% natural loose-leaf ingredients
  • No artificial flavors, fillers or additives
  • Hand-blended and packed in the UK
